name: blaCTX-M (extended-spectrum beta-lactamase)
primary_reference: Davis BC et al. Evaluating Quantitative Metagenomics for Environmental Monitoring of Antibiotic Resistance and Establishing Detection Limits. Environ Sci Technol. 2025.
caveats: Gene presence does not establish that the host organism is clinically relevant. | Metagenomic detection limits are far above qPCR; absence in metagenomes is weak evidence (Davis 2025).

name: blaNDM (carbapenemase)
primary_reference: Davis BC et al. Evaluating Quantitative Metagenomics for Environmental Monitoring of Antibiotic Resistance and Establishing Detection Limits. Environ Sci Technol. 2025.
caveats: Gene presence does not establish that the host organism is clinically relevant. | Metagenomic detection limits are far above qPCR; absence in metagenomes is weak evidence (Davis 2025).

name: intI1 (class 1 integron-integrase)
primary_reference: Davis BC et al. Evaluating Quantitative Metagenomics for Environmental Monitoring of Antibiotic Resistance and Establishing Detection Limits. Environ Sci Technol. 2025.
caveats: Gene presence does not establish that the host organism is clinically relevant. | Metagenomic detection limits are far above qPCR; absence in metagenomes is weak evidence (Davis 2025).

name: sul1 (sulfonamide resistance)
primary_reference: Davis BC et al. Evaluating Quantitative Metagenomics for Environmental Monitoring of Antibiotic Resistance and Establishing Detection Limits. Environ Sci Technol. 2025.
caveats: Gene presence does not establish that the host organism is clinically relevant. | Metagenomic detection limits are far above qPCR; absence in metagenomes is weak evidence (Davis 2025).

name: Candida auris (ITS2 / C. auris-specific qPCR)
conditions: Invasive candidiasis; Healthcare-associated C. auris colonisation
primary_reference: Nwaubani DA et al. Wastewater surveillance of Candida auris in Baltimore. Int J Hyg Environ Health. 2024.
caveats: Detection frequency tracks sewersheds serving healthcare facilities rather than general community prevalence (Barber 2023). | Reported correlation with clinical case counts is weak (r about 0.27, Nwaubani 2024); treat as a facility-level alert signal, not a prevalence estimator.

name: Hepatitis A virus
primary_reference: Chukwu EE et al. Surveillance of public health pathogens in Lagos wastewater canals: a cross-sectional study. BMC Public Health. 2024.

name: Monkeypox virus (mpox), G2R generic target
primary_reference: Sherchan SP et al. Wastewater surveillance of Mpox virus in Baltimore. Sci Total Environ. 2023.
caveats: Detection is sensitive at low case counts; quantitative prevalence calibration is not established.

name: Influenza A virus
primary_reference: Boehm AB et al. Wastewater concentrations of human influenza, metapneumovirus, parainfluenza, respiratory syncytial virus, rhinovirus, and seasonal coronavirus nucleic acids during a COVID-19 pandemic. Lancet Microbe. 2023.
caveats: Cannot distinguish human seasonal from avian/zoonotic influenza A without subtyping.

name: Influenza B virus
primary_reference: Boehm AB et al. Wastewater concentrations of human influenza, metapneumovirus, parainfluenza, respiratory syncytial virus, rhinovirus, and seasonal coronavirus nucleic acids during a COVID-19 pandemic. Lancet Microbe. 2023.

name: Legionella pneumophila (Lpp 24S rRNA target)
primary_reference: Legionella occurrence and molecular detection in wastewater treatment plants (PubMed PMID 28501485).
caveats: Legionella proliferates in the environment rather than being shed by cases, so wastewater load is NOT a shedding-based prevalence proxy. | Building water systems and cooling-tower drainage, not human excretion, dominate the signal.

name: Mycobacterium tuberculosis complex (IS6110 / rpoB)
primary_reference: Mtetwa HN et al. Molecular surveillance of tuberculosis-causing mycobacteria in wastewater. Heliyon. 2022.
caveats: Environmental non-tuberculous mycobacteria cross-react with generic targets; IS6110 copy number varies between strains. | No validated shedding model links wastewater load to TB incidence.

name: Norovirus genogroup II
primary_reference: Boehm AB et al. Wastewater concentrations of human influenza, metapneumovirus, parainfluenza, respiratory syncytial virus, rhinovirus, and seasonal coronavirus nucleic acids during a COVID-19 pandemic. Lancet Microbe. 2023.
caveats: Very high shedding per case; wastewater signal saturates during outbreaks.

name: Poliovirus (Sabin/wild, VP1)
primary_reference: Chukwu EE et al. Surveillance of public health pathogens in Lagos wastewater canals: a cross-sectional study. BMC Public Health. 2024.
caveats: Environmental surveillance for polio is presence/absence oriented, feeding case investigation rather than prevalence estimation.

name: Respiratory syncytial virus (A and B)
primary_reference: Boehm AB et al. Wastewater concentrations of human influenza, metapneumovirus, parainfluenza, respiratory syncytial virus, rhinovirus, and seasonal coronavirus nucleic acids during a COVID-19 pandemic. Lancet Microbe. 2023.

name: Salmonella enterica ser. Typhi (ttr/staG)
primary_reference: Chukwu EE et al. Surveillance of public health pathogens in Lagos wastewater canals: a cross-sectional study. BMC Public Health. 2024.

name: SARS-CoV-2 (N gene)
primary_reference: Sanchez Jimenez B et al. Protocol to longitudinally quantify SARS-CoV-2 RNA in wastewater using RT-qPCR and pepper mild mottle virus normalization. STAR Protoc. 2024.
caveats: Shedding is heterogeneous between individuals and declines over the infection course, so concentration maps to incidence non-linearly.

name: SARS-CoV-2 spike del143/145 variant marker
primary_reference: Sanchez Jimenez B et al. Protocol to longitudinally quantify SARS-CoV-2 RNA in wastewater using RT-qPCR and pepper mild mottle virus normalization. STAR Protoc. 2024.
caveats: A lineage composition marker, not a measure of overall incidence.

name: SARS-CoV-2 spike del69/70 variant marker
primary_reference: Sanchez Jimenez B et al. Protocol to longitudinally quantify SARS-CoV-2 RNA in wastewater using RT-qPCR and pepper mild mottle virus normalization. STAR Protoc. 2024.
caveats: Presence/absence of a deletion marker indicates lineage composition, not overall incidence.

name: SARS-CoV-2 S gene
primary_reference: Sanchez Jimenez B et al. Protocol to longitudinally quantify SARS-CoV-2 RNA in wastewater using RT-qPCR and pepper mild mottle virus normalization. STAR Protoc. 2024.
caveats: Used mainly for variant discrimination rather than absolute burden.

name: Pathogen capsid/nucleoprotein peptides
primary_reference: Pico Y et al. Mass Spectrometry in Wastewater-Based Epidemiology for the Determination of Small and Large Molecules as Biomarkers of Exposure. ACS Omega. 2021.
caveats: Far less sensitive than nucleic-acid amplification at municipal influent concentrations.

name: Bisphenol A
primary_reference: Schmiege D et al. Impact of physicochemical parameters on nicotine metabolites and Bisphenol A in municipal wastewater. Sci Total Environ. 2025.
caveats: Industrial and leachate inputs confound human excretion; an industrial-input flag is required before any exposure inference.

name: Cotinine and trans-3'-hydroxycotinine
primary_reference: Schmiege D et al. Impact of physicochemical parameters on nicotine metabolites and Bisphenol A in municipal wastewater. Sci Total Environ. 2025.

name: Ethyl sulfate
primary_reference: Rousis NI et al. Socioeconomic status and public health in Australia: A wastewater-based study. Environ Int. 2022.

name: 1-Hydroxypyrene
primary_reference: Aghaei M et al. Exposure to environmental pollutants: A mini-review on the application of wastewater-based epidemiology approach. J Environ Health Sci Eng. 2024.

name: 8-hydroxy-2'-deoxyguanosine (8-OHdG)
primary_reference: Kasprzyk-Hordern B et al. Wastewater-based epidemiology for comprehensive community health diagnostics in a national surveillance study: Mining biochemical markers in wastewater. J Hazard Mater. 2023.
caveats: No validated link between community wastewater 8-OHdG and any cancer endpoint.

name: Antihypertensive panel (valsartan, hydrochlorothiazide, amlodipine)
primary_reference: Kasprzyk-Hordern B et al. Wastewater-based epidemiology for comprehensive community health diagnostics in a national surveillance study: Mining biochemical markers in wastewater. J Hazard Mater. 2023.
caveats: Multi-drug class: prescribing mix differs by health system, so a panel total is not comparable between countries without a local prescribing denominator.

name: Atorvastatin and hydroxy-metabolites
primary_reference: Kasprzyk-Hordern B et al. Wastewater-based epidemiology for comprehensive community health diagnostics in a national surveillance study: Mining biochemical markers in wastewater. J Hazard Mater. 2023.
caveats: Low and variable urinary excretion makes back-calculation to prevalence unreliable without local calibration.

name: Capecitabine / 5-fluorouracil residues
primary_reference: Kasprzyk-Hordern B et al. Wastewater-based epidemiology for comprehensive community health diagnostics in a national surveillance study: Mining biochemical markers in wastewater. J Hazard Mater. 2023.
caveats: Concentrations are typically at or below detection limits in municipal influent; a hospital-effluent design is required. | Reflects treatment activity, not cancer incidence.

name: Cortisol and cortisone
conditions: Population stress load; Hypothalamic-pituitary-adrenal axis activity
primary_reference: Kasprzyk-Hordern B et al. Wastewater-based epidemiology for comprehensive community health diagnostics in a national surveillance study: Mining biochemical markers in wastewater. J Hazard Mater. 2023.
caveats: Strong diurnal variation; 24-hour flow-proportional composite sampling is mandatory. | Cortisol/cortisone ratio is more robust than either analyte alone.

name: Human urinary/faecal protein panel (e.g. albumin, calprotectin)
primary_reference: Pico Y et al. Mass Spectrometry in Wastewater-Based Epidemiology for the Determination of Small and Large Molecules as Biomarkers of Exposure. ACS Omega. 2021.
caveats: Proteins degrade rapidly under sewer proteolysis; recovery from municipal influent is not established. | Included to define the proteomics schema. Not usable for inference without a validated recovery and stability study.

name: 8-iso-prostaglandin F2alpha (8-isoprostane)
primary_reference: Kasprzyk-Hordern B et al. Wastewater-based epidemiology for comprehensive community health diagnostics in a national surveillance study: Mining biochemical markers in wastewater. J Hazard Mater. 2023.
caveats: A non-specific stress marker: elevated by inflammation, smoking, air pollution and metabolic disease alike.

name: Metformin
primary_reference: Zhou X et al. Wastewater-based estimation of diabetes mellitus prevalence in 237 cities: A cross-China study. Sci Total Environ. 2024.
caveats: Estimates population *treated* prevalence, not total diabetes prevalence: undiagnosed and non-pharmacologically managed cases are invisible. | Metformin is also prescribed for polycystic ovary syndrome and prediabetes.

name: Bacterial 16S rRNA gene
primary_reference: Davis BC et al. Evaluating Quantitative Metagenomics for Environmental Monitoring of Antibiotic Resistance and Establishing Detection Limits. Environ Sci Technol. 2025.

name: crAssphage (CPQ_056)
primary_reference: Torii S et al. Comparison of five polyethylene glycol precipitation procedures for the RT-qPCR based recovery of murine hepatitis virus, bacteriophage phi6, and pepper mild mottle virus. Sci Total Environ. 2021.

name: Creatinine
primary_reference: Kasprzyk-Hordern B et al. Wastewater-based epidemiology for comprehensive community health diagnostics in a national surveillance study: Mining biochemical markers in wastewater. J Hazard Mater. 2023.
caveats: In-sewer degradation makes creatinine a weaker population marker than hydrochemical flow-based estimates.

name: Pepper mild mottle virus
primary_reference: Sanchez Jimenez B et al. Protocol to longitudinally quantify SARS-CoV-2 RNA in wastewater using RT-qPCR and pepper mild mottle virus normalization. STAR Protoc. 2024.
caveats: Normalisation does not uniformly improve correlation with clinical data; benefit is site-specific (Maal-Bared 2022).
